connection_condition: A school row carries its district name in tab03.fld045; the district is not stored as a separate keyed entity, so the link is by exact district name.
description: A district is composed of the schools that carry its district name; a school record cannot exist without an operating district, and district-level values repeat on every school row.

connection_condition: tab02.fld030 is the CDS code of the reporting unit and corresponds to tab03.fld001 after leading-zero normalization.
description: A SAT report is a performance record attached to a reporting unit; without the school or district there is no meaningful SAT record.

connection_condition: tab01.fld001 equals tab03.fld001 as a 14-character CDS code.
description: A meal-eligibility report is an annual record attached to a school; each school has one row, and the record is meaningless without the school.

connection_condition: The same CDS identifier value appears in tab03.fld001/tab01.fld001 (14 characters) and tab02.fld030 (13 or 14 characters because a leading zero is sometimes dropped).
description: Both terms designate the same school identifier; the SAT table is just a differently formatted representation.

connection_condition: tab03.fld073 and fld074 both hold text grade ranges; they agree on most schools and differ on 2487.
description: The two columns express the same grade-span concept through different recordings; fld073 is the more complete representation.

connection_condition: Excellence rate for a SAT record equals tab02.fld040 divided by tab02.fld036.
description: The excellence rate is derived by dividing the number of test takers scoring at least 1500 by the number of test takers; no stored percentage column exists.

connection_condition: Eligible free rate equals tab01.fld020 divided by tab01.fld019 and is also stored directly in fld021.
description: The K-12 eligible free rate is derived from the free meal count and K-12 enrollment.

connection_condition: Rows with tab03.fld069 = 'SSS' are a subset of directory rows.
description: A State Special School is a specific category of public school; its three rows are a subset of the school directory.

connection_condition: Rows with tab03.fld067 = '66' are a subset of directory rows.
description: A high school is a specific category of school; the 1776 High Schools (Public) rows are a subset of all directory rows.

connection_condition: Administrator name and e-mail are stored in tab03.fld079-fld087 on the same row as the school.
description: The administrator contact is part of the school directory record; it has no independent identifier or record of its own.

connection_condition: The county appears as a text attribute (tab03.fld044) on rows of the district; there is no county table to reference.
description: Districts operate within a county and share its name space, but county and district are related only through text attributes, with no structural identifier link.
